digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified gate
propositions: GitHub Actions runner pool for navapbc/rebar reaches 22 waiting jobs when three concurrent full-route Gerrit Verified dispatches occur, consuming 39 immediate job slots against a Free plan limit of 20 total / 5 macOS concurrent jobs

Current Verified workflow per-run job cost ranges from 17 jobs (no mutation shards) to 24 jobs (all seven mutation shards selected), with 13 full-route jobs fanning out immediately after classification and one macOS job per run

Option A (bundle four preflights, cap mutation matrix at 3) reduces immediate fan-out from 13 to 10 jobs and maximum per-run from 24 to 21, lowering three-run burst demand from 39 to 30 immediate slots while preserving all pre-merge coverage
Option C (move macOS to scheduled main health) eliminates pre-merge macOS coverage but saves 9–11 minutes of wall time per full Verified run by removing the five-job macOS concurrency bottleneck

The incident-period burst of seven runs in five minutes (2026-08-13 20:30 UTC) reached 22 waiting jobs and 873-second runner waits; current three-run bursts reach 22 waiting jobs with 197-second maximum waits, consistent with shared-org contention at the Free plan limit
